notes.subject: to Daniel
notes.rationale: Direct address — Yahwe's message closing words spoken to Daniel.

notes.subject: kontrak
notes.rationale: גורל is literally a pebble/lot cast for division; 'kontrak' holds the assigned-portion sense, the pebble picture is lost.

notes.subject: pinis bilong taim
notes.rationale: The end (קץ) is withheld — Daniel has just been told the words are sealed until the time of the end.

notes.subject: ותעמד
notes.rationale: 'Stand' vs 'arise' — many versions read resurrection nuance here; literal is simply 'stand in your lot'.

translation: Na yu, yu go antap long pinis bilong taim, na yu bai malolo, na yu bai sanap long kontrak bilong yu, long pinis bilong ol de.
